# Dudley's Excavating, Inc.

> Three-generation, family-run Northern California underground contractor (est. 1955, Gerber CA). Flagship: horizontal directional drilling (HDD) under streets, highways, streams and railroads. Also excavation, utility installation, paving, septic (residential), grading, hauling, chip seal. CSLB Class A #694077 · DGS SB #22540 · USDOT 2728939. Serves Tehama, Glenn, Butte and Shasta counties only. Phone 530-385-1445.
